item.itunes:author: 蘋果妹
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2FvYxz_qPiA

值得閱讀的理由

  • 掌握 DJI Pocket 4P 與 Sony ZV-E10 在夜拍、大逆光與邊走邊拍等高難度場景下的真實成像差異。
  • 了解口袋雲台相機與可換鏡頭微單在防手震機制、長焦切換以及動態範圍技術上的核心對比。
  • 分析出門開拍的便利性、內建儲存空間與重量負擔，幫助創作者精準評估最適合自己的 Vlog 拍片設備。

摘要

夜間高對比場景的測光與色彩表現

作者首先在夜晚的店門口進行實測，這類場景光線複雜且招牌極亮、人臉極暗，相當考驗相機的測光能力。DJI Pocket 4P 具備人臉優先功能，能自動兼顧臉部亮度與自然膚色，並透過 10-bit 直出使燈光漸層更平順；而 Sony ZV-E10 則需要手動調整曝光補償在人臉與招牌過曝之間取得平衡，在應對快速抓拍時稍顯繁瑣。

大逆光動態範圍與 LOFIC 技術解析

在面對夕陽大逆光與室內向戶外拍攝的嚴苛考驗下，作者比較了兩台相機的動態範圍。DJI Pocket 4P 採用 LOFIC 技術，有如額外容器承接溢出的光線，大幅降低亮部過曝機率，在 D-Log M 模式下擁有 17 級動態範圍，亦支援 HDR 10-bit 免調色直出，保留窗外與暗部細節；Sony ZV-E10 則依賴 S-Log3 提供寬廣的後製寬容度，但對於追求效率的日常創作者而言 Pocket 4P 的直出更具優勢。

夜間邊走邊拍的防震與長焦切換

作者展示了邊走邊拍與望遠視角的動態效果。DJI Pocket 4P 內建三軸機械雲台，能有效抵消步伐晃動，即使在光線不足時也能維持畫面清晰穩定，同時機身內建 60mm F1.8 的 3 倍長焦鏡頭，單鍵即可快速切換；相較之下，Sony ZV-E10 需仰賴積極防手震帶來的 1.4 倍視角裁切，或搭配體積龐大的外接穩定器，且切換長焦必須額外更換鏡頭，容易錯過精彩瞬間。

攜帶便利性、儲存空間與重量負擔

在實際帶出門的體驗上，作者實測從包包拿出到開拍的流程，DJI Pocket 4P 展現出極高的啟動效率。此外，Pocket 4P 內建 103GB 儲存空間並支援關機後自動傳輸至手機，整機僅重 230 克；而 Sony ZV-E10 機身含電池約 343 克，若加上鏡頭甚至外接望遠鏡頭可能接近 1 公斤，且無內建儲存空間，忘記帶記憶卡便無法運作。

不同拍攝需求的選購指南

作者總結兩台設備的受眾定位：若是注重輕量便攜、出遊紀錄、需要隨拿即拍且不想花費時間鑽研調色與防震的創作者，DJI Pocket 4P 是極為理想的選擇；而若是追求更換鏡頭帶來的極致淺景深、多樣構圖玩法以及熱衷於深入調色的攝影愛好者，Sony ZV-E10 則具備更高的操作彈性與升級空間。

item.itunes:title: iOS 27.2 一定要更新！Siri AI 新增 5 種語言、Apple Music 換新圖示｜iOS 27.2 新功能
item.itunes:author: 蘋果妹
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aeU5Pz9vrVU

值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速掌握 iOS 27.2 的支援機型與更新重點，並了解直接跳過 27.1 版本的原因。
  • 掌握 Siri AI 最新支援的語言現況、搶先體驗技巧以及如何設定排除特定 App 讀取以守護隱私。
  • 提前預覽 FaceTime 前後雙鏡頭、Apple Music 黑白圖示改版、通話紀念日提醒與即將登場的蘋果發表會新品情報。

摘要

iOS 27.2 更新概覽與 Siri AI 新功能

作者指出 iOS 27.2 支援 iPhone 11 以上機型與 SE 第二代，而沒有 27.1 是因該版本為特定新機獨享。本次 Siri AI 新增了法文、日文、韓文、葡萄牙文與西班牙文等 5 種語言，但尚未支援中文；想搶先體驗的使用者可將系統與 Siri 語言切換為支援語系。此外，設定中新增了排除讀取 App 的功能，使用者可自行勾選 LINE、記帳或私密相簿，防止 Siri 讀取敏感個人資料。

FaceTime 與 Apple TV 的個人化升級

在視訊通話方面，FaceTime 群組通話新增支援前後鏡頭同時拍攝功能，視訊連線成員皆能同時展示自拍與環境視角，但該功能限定 iPhone 17 以上及相應版本系統使用。同時，Apple TV App 支援最多 6 個個人檔案並可設定密碼鎖，讓家庭成員各自保有專屬的觀影清單與播放紀錄，避免片單混亂。

訊息智慧建議與 Apple Music 視覺改版

訊息功能在設定為英文語系時支援智慧建議動作，能針對對話中的時間、地址或照片自動顯示加入行事曆、開啟地圖或檢視相簿等快捷鍵。而在視覺設計上，Apple Music 的經典紅色圖示改版為黑白配色，桌面小工具亦同步換上黑底風格，整體視覺更加低調內斂。

貼心細節調整與發表會新品預告

系統亦加入了通話紀念日提醒，在通訊錄設定重要日期後，撥打電話時便會醒目顯示；電池設定圖示也微調為更飽滿簡約的樣式。最後，作者預告即將舉行的蘋果發表會，預計將推出搭載 M5 Pro / Max 晶片並配備 OLED 螢幕的觸控款 MacBook Pro，以及新款 iPad mini、入門款 iPad Pro 與 iMac 等新品。

item.itunes:author: 蘋果妹
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fElD99OmKVM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解 Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 如何透過 14.6 吋大螢幕與三重視窗多工，徹底擺脫平板只是「追劇神器」的刻板印象，成為全天候的專業生產力工具。
  • 掌握創作者如何靈活運用 Gemini Notebook 的 AI 摘要功能與平板專屬版 Photoshop，完成從資料蒐集、腳本草稿到精細修圖的完整工作流。
  • 獲得一整天重度工作下的真實續航數據，以及隨附免充電 S Pen 與鍵盤配件在手寫筆記、繪圖創作及商務會議中的實用價值。

摘要

極致輕薄大螢幕與旗艦級多工效能

作者本次挑戰將一整天的創作工作完全交給 Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra，測試其是否能成為創作者的生產力核心。這款平板配備高達 14.6 吋的 Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz 螢幕，厚度卻僅有驚人的 5.1mm，甚至比隨附的 S Pen 還要輕薄。硬體搭載聯發科天璣 9500處理器，並具備 IP68 防水防塵與 11,600mAh 大容量電池。作者指出，超大螢幕的最大優勢在於能流暢開啟三重視窗多工，同時並列資料查閱、文字撰寫與 AI 工具，徹底告別頻繁切換應用程式的繁瑣操作。

導入 Gemini Notebook：一站式 AI 知識庫與語音摘要

針對影片創作中最耗時的資料蒐集階段，作者展示了如何運用 Gemini Notebook 提升效率。無論是 PDF 文件、網頁連結、圖片甚至是錄音檔，都能直接匯入建立個人專屬的 AI 資料庫。使用者可以直接針對資料發問，系統會在不捏造事實的前提下精準回答並附上來源依據。此外，作者特別推崇其音訊摘要功能，能一鍵將龐雜資訊轉化為雙人對話形式的 Podcast 語音，方便在通勤或空檔中以聆聽方式快速吸收重點，並在開拍前進行重點快問快答以確保資訊正確無誤。

S Pen 搭配 Notability：流暢手寫分鏡與高效會議記錄

在腳本撰寫階段，作者使用預載於平板中的 Notability 進行分鏡草繪與大綱梳理。隨附的 S Pen 無需充電即可隨取隨寫，按壓筆身按鈕即可直接切換為橡皮擦，手感極為直覺。利用大螢幕優勢，作者能同時開啟資料網頁、AI 摘要與筆記視窗，即時標註重點。而在商務會議時，平板內建豐富的會議紀錄與待辦清單範本，會議結束後接上鍵盤保護套即可切換如筆記型電腦般的高速打字輸入模式，大幅簡化行政與整理流程。

首度預載專屬 Photoshop 與 Galaxy AI 創意工坊

午後的封面製作環節，作者展示了首度登陸 Android 平板的平板專屬版 Photoshop。透過 S Pen 的極細筆尖，使用者可以直接在螢幕上進行精準去背、AI 智慧擴圖、污點消除與色調調整，操作比起滑鼠更加直覺，讓作者不必回到電腦前就能在平板上完成專業級的宣傳封面。此外，平板內建的 Galaxy AI 創意工坊 還能將隨筆塗鴉自動生成風格獨特的貼圖、桌布或賀卡，兼具日常工作應用與放鬆療癒的創作趣味。

長效續航表現與創作者工具總結

經過一整天高強度的搜尋、寫作、繪圖與修圖實測，作者發現平板僅消耗約 60% 的電力，推算充飽電約可支撐長達一天半的重度工作，續航表現十分出色。作者總結認為，這款裝置重量遠比筆電輕盈，非常適合需要大量整理資料的學生、頻繁開會簡報的商務人士，以及需要隨處創作的影像工作者。結合官方附贈的多款實用軟體試用方案，這款平板已經遠遠超脫單純的娛樂設備，具備完全取代筆電日常辦公的強大實力。

================================================

Do you all end up using your tablets as binge-watching devices after buying them? I used to be the same way. So this time, I wanted to try something different: I completely handed over my daily work to this Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. I used it for everything: researching, writing, meetings with manufacturers, and creating covers. In the end , I even used it to create a set of stickers for my friend CC. So, can a tablet really support a creator's day ? Today, we 'll do a hands-on test to see. First, let's look at its appearance. The 14.6-inch screen is huge, and it's only 5.1mm thick. I've placed the included S Pen next to it for you to see.

Can you see that the tablet itself is thinner than the pen? So, what's the advantage of a large screen? Many people would probably think of watching videos first , but I think the most useful thing isn't that. It's being able to open three windows at once : the left for information , the middle for writing, and the right for AI. You can view all three at once without constantly switching between them. This is what I use most often for my work. The screen is a Dynamic AMOLED 2X 120Hz , which is very smooth to use and the colors are beautiful. The chip inside is a MediaTek Dimensity 9500. When you.

open three windows simultaneously, including Photoshop , you can see how smoothly the switching is. This is a large device , and I mostly use it on my desk or propped up with a keyboard cover. It's IP68 waterproof and dustproof, and even has an S Pen. Its battery is 11,600mAh, which the official claim is up to 23 hours of video playback. It supports 45W fast charging. Today, I used it for a full day of work, and by the time I got home and watched TV, how much battery was left? Well, my job involves filming videos every day. The most time-consuming part of filming isn't the filming process itself , but the research and data collection. For an unboxing video,.

I might need to look at manufacturer information, the official website , or many foreign reports . Before, I would manually open each page and read through them one by one, often forgetting what I had read earlier , or having to manually copy information repeatedly – ​​it was incredibly tedious. Now, I put everything into the Gemini Notebook. Its greatest strength is that it can directly put in any type of file, such as PDFs, URLs, photos , and even my own recorded audio. It becomes your personal AI in one place. The database allows you to ask it any questions, such as " What are the five key points of this video? " It will answer based solely on the information I provide,.

without making things up. You can also click on each sentence to see which source it comes from. My favorite feature is that it can turn this information into a podcast episode . By clicking on the audio summary, the AI ​​will generate a podcast in the form of a conversation between two people, explaining the key points to you in a chat-like manner. The voice is incredibly realistic. Just press one button, and it instantly transforms into a supercomputing center with four independent workspaces . Yes, this is the information we'll be dissecting in today's in-depth analysis. I think it's incredibly useful! For example, you can use it for commuting.

or learning anything. My personal habit is that after listening, I go back to my tablet and ask again about things I think are important, such as the differences between this generation and the previous one , or which features are most important to everyone. Finally, it can also... Before filming, I'll give you a quiz. You might think it's necessary to do this, but it really is. Because if I make a mistake in any specification, someone in the comments section will definitely notice and point it out. However, researching isn't what I use this tablet for most. The most common use is... After researching, the next step is writing the script. When I write, I usually start by hand.

sketching out the order of what I'm going to say and the visuals. Here, I'm using Notability. Many people have probably heard of it. It used to support fewer products, so many students bought tablets specifically for it. Now, it's also available on Samsung tablets , and it comes pre-installed with the Samsung tablet that comes with it. The pen is incredibly user-friendly , and it doesn't need charging— just pick it up and start writing. Even if you make a mistake, you don't need to switch tools. The button on the pen turns it into an eraser. For example, if the manufacturer provides PDF materials, you can import them directly and highlight key points. At this point, I can open three windows simultaneously: one for highlighting in Gemini Notebook.

, another for Notability's handwritten outline , and yet another in a browser for easy access to information. Because the screen is large , even three side-by-side texts are clearly visible . If I have a meeting with the manufacturer at noon, I'll open a new notepad. It has many ready-made templates, like meeting minutes or to-do lists; I can choose one and write directly without drawing grids . After the meeting , all the tasks are listed on it. Once the outline is complete , I'll connect the keyboard cover to type it out . It looks like a computer, and typing and opening windows are similar to using a laptop . Next, in the afternoon, I'll work on the cover,.

which is what I find most special about this device : it comes pre-installed with Photoshop —the first time an Android tablet has Photoshop built-in. This app is amazing! Photoshop is something I use every day, and I'm incredibly impressed. Plus, it's a tablet-specific version! All the tools are listed here, and you can use the S Pen directly. For example, if I take a product photo on my phone, I can quickly share it to my tablet, open Photoshop , and use the S Pen to select the product and create effects like background removal. The S Pen tip can make very fine dots. Even the smallest details can be defined . In Photoshop, expanding or generating images is also very convenient.

For example, if I don't like a cluttered background, I can directly remove it , or if I want to adjust the size of the photo, I can generate it directly. In the color adjustment section, product photos sometimes come out a bit dark or gray. In this case, I can adjust the brightness, contrast , or color by simply dragging with the pen , and it will look different immediately. Finally, add the text card, and the cover is done. In the past, making a cover required going back to the computer , but now I can do it anywhere with a tablet . And retouching directly on the screen with the pen is more intuitive than using a mouse. The cover image card can be completed in one afternoon. Finally, I want to introduce the Galaxy AI Creative Studio, which I really like . It can directly create stickers.

For example, I use the S Pen. I casually drew a CC ( Cyclops), and it's not very good, but that's okay. I chose a style, and it turned my sketch into a set of stickers , which are quite cute. For example, you can use them directly for messages or Instagram posts. Besides stickers, it can also turn photos or sentences into wallpapers or cards. For example, you can make a card for a friend's birthday, which is more thoughtful than buying one. This kind of thing isn't just for work; you can pick it up and draw whenever you have free time. I think this tablet is really therapeutic. Finally, let's talk about the battery life . I used it from morning to night, and it used about 60% of the battery.

That means a full charge lasts about a day and a half. I think the battery life is great. If you need to take it to work, it's fine because I really use it like a laptop. It's much lighter than a laptop, so whether it's commuting, business trips , or just wanting to work in a coffee shop, it's much less burdensome . In conclusion , if you're a student who needs to organize a lot of class materials every day , an office worker who often attends meetings and gives presentations , or a creator like me who needs to research, write articles , or meet with manufacturers, this Galaxy Tab is a great choice.
